reviews.title: Meh Build Quality, Compact, missing some QOLs features, and possibly long term problems
reviews.comment: Hello! Wanted to give my review about this case and what you should know about it. This comes with 3 ARGB/PWM fans that daisy chain to one header to your motherboard. The cable management in the back is very compact. You will have issues with routing power cables back there and would be no space if you use sleeved cable extensions. They only provided me 6 total motherboard standoffs. That's not enough for normal matx motherboards. Be careful picking a motherboard with the USB 3.0 Header the angled to the right of the motherboard. In my experience, mine was and couldn't use it which impacted front 3.0 and Type C ports not working. Would I recommend building with this case? For someone who's building their first PC, I'd stay away from using this case and for experienced builders. Stay wary from the downsides from what I previously stated.
